forbid.message:
Raw

decides the type scale a second time. Render copy through Text from @bc-solutions-coder/ui (, or MutedText for secondary copy) so the catalog owns the scale.
Raw <span> decides the type scale a second time. Render copy through Text from @bc-solutions-coder/ui (<Text as="span">, or MutedText for secondary copy) so the catalog owns the scale.
Raw <legend> decides the type scale a second time. Render the group's caption through Text from @bc-solutions-coder/ui (<Text as="legend">) so the catalog owns the scale.

Raw <code> decides the type scale a second time. Render inline code through Text from @bc-solutions-coder/ui (<Text as="code">) so the catalog owns the scale. Preformatted OUTPUT stays a raw <pre> — it is not copy.

Raw <h1> decides the type scale a second time. Render headings through Text from @bc-solutions-coder/ui (<Text as="h1" variant="title">), or through PageHeader for a page title. The variant names a step on Text's scale — display, title, heading, subheading — not the element.

Raw <h2> decides the type scale a second time. Render headings through Text from @bc-solutions-coder/ui (<Text as="h2" variant="subheading">), or through the Card and Section headings that already wrap it. Text DERIVES a much larger step from `as` when no variant is named.

Raw <h3> decides the type scale a second time. Render headings through Text from @bc-solutions-coder/ui (<Text as="h3" variant="subheading">), or through the Card and Section headings that already wrap it.
Raw <h4> decides the type scale a second time. Render headings through Text from @bc-solutions-coder/ui (<Text as="h4" variant="...">), or through the Card and Section headings that already wrap it.
Raw <h5> decides the type scale a second time. Render headings through Text from @bc-solutions-coder/ui (<Text as="h5">), or through the Card and Section headings that already wrap it.
Raw <h6> decides the type scale a second time. Render headings through Text from @bc-solutions-coder/ui (<Text as="h6">), or through the Card and Section headings that already wrap it.
